# This MiniCluster manifest is designed to run the LAMMPS HPC application
# on a single AWS CPU-based instance within a Kubernetes cluster,
# managed by the Flux Operator.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name of the MiniCluster resource.
  name: lammps-minicluster
  # Deployment will be in the 'default' namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # Specify the size of the cluster, which corresponds to the number of pods.
  # For this single-node experiment, the size is set to 1.
  size: 1

  # Total number of tasks for the job. Flux will distribute these tasks
  # across the pods defined by 'size'.
  tasks: 4

  # Defines the application container to be run within the MiniCluster.
  containers:
    - image: lammps
      # The command to execute the LAMMPS simulation.
      # The Flux Operator automatically prepends 'flux run -n <tasks>' to this command.
      command: /lammps/build/lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
      
      # The name of the container.
      name: lammps

      # Ensures this container is treated as a worker, not a job submission pod.
      launcher: false

      # The image pull policy is set to 'Never' as instructed.
      # This assumes the 'lammps' container image is already present on the node.
      imagePullPolicy: Never

  # Logging configuration for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Ensures strict schema validation for the job specification.
    strict: true

  # Job cleanup policy.
  # When set to false, the pods and their logs are retained after the job completes.
  cleanup: false
